title: VoltPilot additional measurement sample batch (2.1: provenance fields)
description: Additive successor of mqtt-measurement-samples.schema.json (2.0, unchanged and still valid on the same topic). 2.1 = 2.0 plus exactly two OPTIONAL provenance fields of the per-value provenance contract (messwert-herkunft.md, UEMS AP-07 IP-2): applied_revision per envelope and entity_id per sample. Every other unknown field is still refused. The new fields exist ONLY under schema_version 2.1; a 2.0 envelope carrying them is invalid. See mqtt-measurement-samples-2.1.md.

applied_revision.description: OPTIONAL (2.1). The settings revision (Einstellungs-Fassung, AP-04 E5) the box APPLIED when it captured every sample of this envelope - the provenance field einstellungs_fassung / umschlag.angewendete_fassung of messwert-herkunft. Absent = the box does not report it (the state of before): the cloud looks up the revision applied at the measuring time from the delivery (applied_at), never guesses it.

entity_id.description: OPTIONAL (2.1). The component (registry entity id, the same UUID as selections[].entity_id of mqtt-measurement-config) this point was read FOR - the provenance field komponente of messwert-herkunft. Never the customer's Kennzeichen. Absent = the box does not name it (an older box, or a selection without an entity binding): the cloud resolves it from the selection, and an ambiguous one is a mirror - never guessed.

x-identity-rule: The three topic identity segments MUST byte-equal the payload identity fields.
x-honesty-rule: A sample exists only after a physical/protocol read. raw is the received value; decoded MUST NOT be inverted to manufacture raw.
x-compat-rule: Additive (house rule 'contracts are additive', AP-07 W4): the same topic carries 2.0 and 2.1 side by side; ingest accepts both. A 2.0 envelope is exactly the 2.0 contract - it never carries applied_revision or entity_id. point_key stays unique per envelope, as in 2.0.
